examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The cache figure at rest. Move the pointer over it, or focus the page and use the arrow keys over it, to see it answer; its accessible name is the figure's own description unless `aria-label` is set.

examples.name: Play
examples.summary: `play` walks the figure through its answer on its own until a pointer or focus arrives, and `read` reports each reading so the page can show it. Under reduced motion the figure holds a still frame.

examples.name: Gallery
examples.summary: All 25 registered figures, one per product. Each loads on demand, so a page pays only for the figures it draws.

examples.name: In an empty state
examples.summary: `azion-404` as the art of an `EmptyState`. The `icon` slot sizes to its content, so the figure alone takes its natural 400×320 size there (capped by the space available); a sized wrapper sets a smaller one.
